text: His son Ismail was born. And then came a test that no father would choose.
By Allah's command, Ibrahim brought the baby and his mother to a dry valley, with no water, no plants, and no people. The valley of Makkah.

He left them there, with a bag of dates and a skin of water. As he walked away, the mother called after him: has Allah commanded you to do this? He said: yes. And she said: then He will not abandon us.
And Ibrahim turned to the sky and prayed: "Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, that they may establish prayer."
When the water ran out, the mother ran between two hills, Safa and Marwa, seven times, searching for any sign of help.
And at the baby's feet, water burst from the ground. The spring of Zamzam. It is still flowing today.
Every pilgrim who walks between Safa and Marwa is walking in the footsteps of a mother who trusted Allah.
